rules.name: semantic_lineweight_hierarchy
rules.requirement: Plan-cut walls and columns shall plot heavier than visible projections; visible projections shall plot heavier than furniture, grids, routes and dimensions.
rules.failureCause: Layer membership or color alone was treated as drafting semantics, so every object rendered with one stroke width.
rules.prevention: Resolve lineweight from typed object role before DXF and preview generation and fail when cut > projection > annotation is not provable.

rules.name: semantic_linetype_hierarchy
rules.requirement: Cut and visible projection geometry shall be continuous, hidden or overhead geometry shall be dashed, and grids shall use a center pattern.
rules.failureCause: All layers inherited Continuous because the linetype table and model-space scale were never configured.
rules.prevention: Install standard linetypes, assign them BYLAYER, validate effective entity linetypes, and verify a visible dash cadence at the intended scale.

rules.name: native_dimension_style
rules.requirement: Dimensions shall remain native DIMENSION entities using a named millimetre architectural DIMSTYLE with integer precision, extension gaps, extension overshoot and architectural ticks.
rules.failureCause: Per-entity temporary overrides hid an unconfigured default DIMSTYLE and made reopen behaviour host-dependent.
rules.prevention: Persist every required DIMSTYLE variable in the table and reject exploded dimension text or geometry.

rules.name: dimension_layout
rules.requirement: Chain dimensions shall be closest to the plan, overall dimensions shall be farther out, and annotation shall not overlap model geometry or other labels.
rules.failureCause: Dimensions were added after geometry without a dedicated annotation envelope or collision check.
rules.prevention: Reserve an annotation band, order chain/overall levels mathematically, and run bounding-box collision checks before delivery.

rules.name: cross_renderer_parity
rules.requirement: DWG/DXF, raster preview and interactive reviewer shall preserve the same semantic lineweight and linetype hierarchy.
rules.failureCause: The interactive reviewer used one hard-coded SVG stroke width even though the DXF layers carried different lineweights.
rules.prevention: Propagate cad_layer to each selectable SVG entity and regression-test layer classes, dash patterns and widths.

rules.name: whole_drawing_review
rules.requirement: Automated delivery review shall inspect layer tables, effective entity styles, DIMSTYLE, annotation layout and a real rendered view before opening the candidate.
rules.failureCause: Geometry validity was accepted as drawing quality, so drafting defects escaped coordinate and topology checks.
rules.prevention: Gate delivery on structural, drafting-data and visual checks; record the root cause and candidate prevention rule for every failure.

rules.name: complete_axis_grid_object_group
rules.requirement: Every architectural plan axis shall be delivered as one typed group containing a center-pattern axis line, two tangent axis bubbles and two centered identical identifiers.
rules.failureCause: GRID was modelled only as a linetype, so the drawing contained centerlines but no visible axis identity.
rules.prevention: Generate line, bubbles and identifiers from one axis record; reject missing pairs, off-centre labels, non-tangent endpoints or orphan members.

rules.name: cross_floor_axis_identity
rules.requirement: The same global X or Y datum shall retain the same axis identifier across all storeys, while different global datums shall not share an identifier in one direction.
rules.failureCause: Each floor restarted local numbering and ignored storey transforms, allowing one structural datum to change names between plans.
rules.prevention: Build the axis catalogue in global coordinates before any floor plan, then validate local coordinate plus floor transform against that catalogue.

rules.name: discipline_annotation_completeness_matrix
rules.requirement: Before delivery, architectural plan outputs shall satisfy the stage-appropriate matrix for axes, room names, dimensions, door/window tags, stair direction, level datum, north indicator, section/elevation references and sheet/scale data; omissions must be declared, never silently ignored.
rules.failureCause: Geometry checks proved that objects existed but did not prove that a human reviewer could identify or navigate them.
rules.prevention: Select a discipline and drawing-stage profile at plan time, expand its required annotation set, and fail the completeness gate for every missing required class.

rules.name: symbol_and_tag_geometry_binding
rules.requirement: Door, window, stair, level, north and section/elevation symbols shall bind to the geometry they describe and preserve identifier uniqueness and legibility.
rules.failureCause: Labels were emitted as free text with no association to source geometry, so later edits could leave misleading annotations behind.
rules.prevention: Assign stable semantic IDs, store source references/XData, derive tag positions from geometry and re-run binding checks after every modification.

rules.name: typography_collision_and_plot_scale
rules.requirement: Text height, axis bubble size, dimension offsets, lineweight and dash cadence shall be resolved from the declared plot scale and pass collision/readability checks in CAD, raster/PDF and the interactive reviewer.
rules.failureCause: Model-space coordinates were correct but fixed display styling created overlapping, tiny or visually uniform output at another renderer or scale.
rules.prevention: Use one scale-aware drafting profile and reserve annotation envelopes before rendering; compare semantic classes across all output backends.

rules.name: failure_learning_feedback
rules.requirement: Every failed drafting gate shall emit the symptom, root cause, correction and a candidate prevention rule with a reproducible regression fixture.
rules.failureCause: One-off visual repairs corrected a drawing without changing the generator, so the same low-level error returned in later jobs.
rules.prevention: Convert confirmed defects into rule IDs, executable checks and tests; keep new rules disabled for automatic acceptance until reviewed.

rules.name: structural_axis_coverage_scope
rules.requirement: Axis extents shall come from a declared structural coverage scope, not from the undifferentiated bounding box of every visible equipment, bridge, route or note.
rules.failureCause: The generator reused the whole-drawing content envelope for datum geometry, so one remote appendage stretched every axis across empty space.
rules.prevention: Maintain separate full-content, structural-axis and annotation envelopes; require each remote appendage to declare whether it participates in the primary grid.

rules.name: idempotent_audit_report_inventory
rules.requirement: Validation and audit reports shall contain one complete symptom/root-cause/correction/prevention record per stable rule ID, and repeated generator runs over unchanged inputs shall produce the same canonical inventory.
rules.failureCause: A post-validator appended lessons to its own previous output, so every rerun duplicated rule records even though the CAD candidate was unchanged.
rules.prevention: Merge lessons through stable rule IDs, reject conflicting duplicate content, audit uniqueness/completeness and regression-test repeat-run hashes before delivery.

rules.name: model_and_paperspace_sheet_gate
rules.requirement: Construction-stage output shall include populated paper-space sheets with bound viewports, title blocks, drawing numbers, plot scales, revisions, statuses and schedule/navigation references.
rules.failureCause: Model-space geometry was treated as a complete drawing even though the published layouts were empty.
rules.prevention: Validate model geometry and every required paper-space sheet as separate non-compensatory gates.

rules.name: recognisable_furniture_component_matrix
rules.requirement: Furniture required by the brief shall be selectable linework whose typed component matrix makes the object recognisable without relying on its label or fill.
rules.failureCause: An occupancy rectangle and object name were mistaken for detailed furniture geometry.
rules.prevention: Define minimum components per furniture family, including sofa back, arms, seat/front and cushion divisions, and validate scale and clearance.

rules.name: axis_grid_stage_contract
rules.requirement: Every architectural sheet shall declare its axis convention, primary/secondary grid scope, identifier direction, cross-storey identity and exceptions for irregular or remote appendages.
rules.failureCause: A fixed regular grid was copied to every plan without proving that it represented the structural or coordination datum system.
rules.prevention: Generate axes from a project datum catalogue and a declared coverage contract; reject unbound, duplicated, omitted or gratuitously extended axes.

rules.name: fail_closed_construction_release
rules.requirement: A drawing shall not be labelled or exposed as construction/production output unless the production-readiness contract proves drafting, discipline authority, native-host persistence and authorized release evidence.
rules.failureCause: More annotation was assumed to turn a concept drawing into a construction document.
rules.prevention: Run production-readiness QA after drawing QA; on any failed gate, expose only the blocker report or an explicitly marked review candidate.

rules.name: route_furniture_clearance_revalidation
rules.requirement: Every furniture, equipment or route edit shall trigger a full-route clearance check; a route centreline shall not intersect any controlled occupancy plus its declared clearance envelope.
rules.failureCause: Furniture component QA passed, but the downstream circulation graph was not replayed after the furniture layout changed.
rules.prevention: Register route clearance as a dependency of all furniture/equipment geometry and fail the whole drawing on any segment-envelope intersection.

rules.name: symbol_annotation_clearance_revalidation
rules.requirement: Routes, grids and other symbolic lines shall not cross annotation text envelopes; editing either the symbol geometry or the annotation shall replay the clearance gate.
rules.failureCause: Object clearance QA ignored the separately rendered tag/text envelope, allowing a route to remain geometrically valid but visually obscure a window identifier.
rules.prevention: Bind every tag envelope to symbolic-line collision checks and fail when the scale-aware minimum separation is not met.

rules.name: room_function_equipment_completeness
rules.requirement: Every named room shall declare a functional category and pass both the built-in category equipment profile and its project-specific required-equipment set; labels and occupancy rectangles do not satisfy the requirement.
rules.failureCause: Whole-drawing entity counts allowed kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms and service rooms to remain empty or to contain only generic boxes.
rules.prevention: Validate the equipment family set room by room, bind every equipment item to a room polygon and block compilation when a required family is missing.

rules.name: interior_object_semantic_layering
rules.requirement: Movable furniture, fixed casework, sanitary fixtures and appliances shall use separate semantic layers and retain selectable component linework.
rules.failureCause: All interior objects were collapsed onto FURNITURE, so display, plotting, coordination and local correction could not distinguish their technical roles.
rules.prevention: Map every typed equipment family to FURNITURE, CASEWORK, SANITARY or APPLIANCE before generation and reject layer-family mismatches.

rules.name: purpose_complete_dimension_chain_matrix
rules.requirement: Architectural plans shall contain distinct native dimension chains for overall extent, structural grid, major partitions and openings, with each entity bound to one declared purpose.
rules.failureCause: A dimension count passed even though only overall and grid dimensions existed, leaving partitions and openings unlocatable for construction review.
rules.prevention: Validate the four-purpose dimension-chain matrix before artifact exposure and preserve native DIMENSION entities through host save and reopen.

rules.name: door_host_opening_sweep_topology
rules.requirement: Every door shall reference an existing host wall and opening; the wall shall be segmented around that opening; hinge, opening endpoint, leaf length, arc endpoint, required sweep and equipment clearance shall agree mathematically.
rules.failureCause: Door leaves and arcs were drawn as independent symbols with no host-wall topology, allowing floating hinges, continuous walls through doors and arcs disconnected from their leaves.
rules.prevention: Create the door from one host-opening record, derive all door geometry from it and replay topology plus sweep-clearance checks after any wall, opening, door or equipment edit.

rules.name: precompile_architectural_detail_gate
rules.requirement: Axis identity, room equipment, semantic layers, dimension purposes, door topology, annotation completeness and stage authority shall pass one non-compensatory contract before CAD compilation or review launch.
rules.failureCause: Independent post-export checks found defects only after a visually polished but technically inconsistent drawing had already been exposed to the user.
rules.prevention: Run the architectural detail contract before compile; on any failure expose only machine-readable and Chinese blocker reports with root cause and disabled prevention-rule candidates.

rules.name: typed_selectable_detailed_object_linework
rules.requirement: Every required furniture, casework, sanitary fixture and appliance shall use actual-size selectable line, arc or circle components whose typed roles satisfy its versioned symbol profile; text, fills, blocks without subcomponents and occupancy rectangles are forbidden substitutes.
rules.failureCause: A bounding rectangle and object label were counted as a furnished room even though the CAD contained no recognisable sofa cushions, bed pillows, fixture cores, drains, controls or other functional detail.
rules.prevention: Bind every component role to a resolved AICAD entity, prove exact closed outline, profile-specific role counts, permitted primitive types, semantic layer, actual size, object bbox and clearance bbox before any CAD artifact is exposed.

rules.name: strict_production_only_artifact_exposure
rules.requirement: When strictProductionOnly is enabled, every architecture request shall use stage=production and pass the complete production drawing-set matrix, detailed linework, authority, native-host, visual and authorized-release gates; otherwise CAD artifacts and review launch are forbidden.
rules.failureCause: Concept or coordination drawings were still compiled and presented after a blocker report, making users repeatedly inspect artifacts that were known not to be construction-ready.
rules.prevention: Use production_release_candidate_only exposure, allowIntermediateCad=false and blocker formats JSON plus UTF-8 HTML plus opaque PNG; a failed gate emits only readable diagnostics with root cause and no DXF/DWG/SCR/AICAD.

rules.name: portable_human_readable_blocker_review
rules.requirement: Every failed architectural gate shall emit machine JSON and a local single-file UTF-8 HTML review plus an opaque white-background PNG summary; the HTML shall contain every check, expandable evidence, root cause and prevention rule without external services.
rules.failureCause: Markdown and JSON were valid but depended on desktop file association and local-link handling, so users repeatedly saw an unable-to-open result and could not inspect the evidence.
rules.prevention: Render reports through aicad_review_report.py, verify HTML charset and Chinese content, verify PNG RGB mode and white background, and make the HTML path the primary review entry.

rules.name: mathematically_bound_axis_group
rules.requirement: Every structural axis shall bind one center-pattern line at its declared coordinate, two equal-radius exterior bubbles tangent to opposite line endpoints, and two identical centered identifiers; numeric and letter identifiers shall follow one coordinate-ordered global catalogue.
rules.failureCause: The earlier precompile gate counted axis members but did not prove line coordinate, bubble tangency, exterior placement or identifier text/centering, so malformed axes could satisfy a superficial completeness count.
rules.prevention: Resolve every axis as one typed mathematical group, bind all five entities by ID, validate coordinate/span/tangency/centering/order before compilation, and replay the group after structural or annotation edits.
